name: 33415 · West Palm Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33415 (West Palm Bch) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33415 (West Palm Bch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33415 (West Palm Bch) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
